dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「お待たせしました」
dialogues.en: "Sorry for making you wait."
dialogues.text: "Sorry for making you wait."

dialogues.jp:
ＨＲ終了後ほどなくして、俺の席に萌先輩が迎
えにやって来た。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai came to pick me up after the homeroom ended.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai came to pick me up after the homeroom ended.

dialogues.jp:
「いえ、そんなに待ってないんで。すみません
　けど、鞄お願いします」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't wait that long. I'm sorry but could you get my
bag?"
dialogues.text:
"I didn't wait that long. I'm sorry but could you get my
bag?"

dialogues.jp:
席を立ち萌先輩に鞄を預け、松葉杖を両脇にセッ
トする。
dialogues.en:
I stood up and gave my bag to Moe-sempai, and held the
crutches under my armpits.
dialogues.text:
I stood up and gave my bag to Moe-sempai, and held the
crutches under my armpits.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「春ですねー」
dialogues.en: "It's spring now......"
dialogues.text: "It's spring now......"

dialogues.jp:
舞い散る桜の花びらに手を差し伸べ、萌先輩が
おだやかに微笑む。
dialogues.en:
She smiled softly as she reached her hands toward the
falling cherry blossom petals.
dialogues.text:
She smiled softly as she reached her hands toward the
falling cherry blossom petals.

dialogues.jp:
いや、いつも咲いてる桜で春を実感されても
……。
dialogues.en: Although we have cherry blossoms every season here......
dialogues.text: Although we have cherry blossoms every season here......

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうしました？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いや……そういえば、今日って火曜日じゃな
　かったでしたっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Well...... isn't today Tuesday?"
dialogues.text: "Well...... isn't today Tuesday?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい、そうです」
dialogues.en: "Yes it is."
dialogues.text: "Yes it is."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「部活って、今日でしたよね？」
dialogues.en: "I thought you had your club meeting today......"
dialogues.text: "I thought you had your club meeting today......"

dialogues.jp:
ふと、音楽部の活動日を思い出す。確か火・木・
土曜だったはず。
dialogues.en:
I suddenly remembered what days the music club had their
practices. I believe it's Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays.
dialogues.text:
I suddenly remembered what days the music club had their
practices. I believe it's Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。でも今日はお休みです」
dialogues.en: "Yes, but I'm off today."
dialogues.text: "Yes, but I'm off today."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩だが、それってサボりっ
て言うんじゃ……。
dialogues.en: She smiled at me but I think she's just skipping......
dialogues.text: She smiled at me but I think she's just skipping......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「今日は身近な荷物を朝倉くんのお家に運ぼう
　かと思うんですけど……いいですか？」
dialogues.en:
"I'm thinking about taking some essentials over to your home
today...... Is that all right with you?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm thinking about taking some essentials over to your home
today...... Is that all right with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……身近な……荷物？」
dialogues.en: "Some essentials......?"
dialogues.text: "Some essentials......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「泊まりなら、あのデカイ鞄に入っていた荷物
　で充分だと……」
dialogues.en:
"I thought what you brought in that huge suitcase should be
enough for you to live on......"
dialogues.text:
"I thought what you brought in that huge suitcase should be
enough for you to live on......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……だめ、でしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "So...... You don't want me to bring anything?"
dialogues.text: "So...... You don't want me to bring anything?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁ、構わないですけど」
dialogues.en: "......Well, I don't mind."
dialogues.text: "......Well, I don't mind."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の不安げな眼差しに見つめられ、勝手に
口が動いてしまった。
dialogues.en:
My mouth answered against my will as she stared at me with a
sad face.
dialogues.text:
My mouth answered against my will as she stared at me with a
sad face.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、いっか」
dialogues.en: "Oh well."
dialogues.text: "Oh well."

dialogues.jp: 毒食らわば皿までって言うし。
dialogues.en: They say one might as well be hanged for a sheep as a lamb.
dialogues.text: They say one might as well be hanged for a sheep as a lamb.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……あとでお買い物に付き合って頂けま
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... could you go shopping with me later?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... could you go shopping with me later?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いいですよ」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の嬉しそうな笑顔を見ながら、なんだか
最近、色々なことが、どうでも良くなっている
気がした。
dialogues.en:
As I stared at her joyful face, I realized I've been feeling
so nonchalant about everything lately.
dialogues.text:
As I stared at her joyful face, I realized I've been feeling
so nonchalant about everything lately.

dialogues.jp: 慣れか……。
dialogues.en: I guess I'm getting used to her pace......
dialogues.text: I guess I'm getting used to her pace......

dialogues.jp: ◆泊まりじゃない◆
dialogues.en: ◆Not just a sleepover◆
dialogues.text: ◆Not just a sleepover◆

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩との帰り道。俺の家に、身近な荷物を運
びたいと、萌先輩は言った。
dialogues.en:
On our way back home, Moe-sempai said she wants to move some
essentials into my home.
dialogues.text:
On our way back home, Moe-sempai said she wants to move some
essentials into my home.

dialogues.jp:
前に持ってきたのだけじゃなかったのか……。
もしや、萌先輩の頭の中では、泊まりの｛はんちゅう／範疇｝を
越えている？
dialogues.en:
I thought she brought enough before...... Is she planning
something more than a sleepover?
dialogues.text:
I thought she brought enough before...... Is she planning
something more than a sleepover?
